tabs.softwareDescriptionWindows: Third-party apps via winget, Chocolatey, Scoop & npm

softwareUpdater.pageDescription: Check for outdated software and install updates
softwareUpdater.managerEnabledHint: {{manager}} enabled — click to stop scanning it
softwareUpdater.managerScanFailedHint: Its packages are missing from the results below — updates may still be available.
softwareUpdater.severityLegendTitle: What do the update types mean?

severityLegend.major: The first version number changes. This may bring larger changes to the program.
severityLegend.minor: The second number changes. This usually indicates improvements or new features.
severityLegend.patch: The third number changes. This usually includes smaller fixes and security fixes.

softwareUpdater.severityLegendNote: This classification is based on version numbering. For exact details, check the software developer's release notes.

packageManagerNotFound.brewRequired: Homebrew is required. Install it from
packageManagerNotFound.wingetRequired: Windows Package Manager is required. Install it from the
packageManagerNotFound.chocoRequired: Chocolatey is required. Install it from
packageManagerNotFound.aptRequired: APT package manager is required. It should be pre-installed on Debian and Ubuntu systems.
packageManagerNotFound.dnfRequired: DNF package manager is required. It should be pre-installed on Fedora and RHEL systems.
packageManagerNotFound.pacmanRequired: Pacman package manager is required. It should be pre-installed on Arch Linux systems.
packageManagerNotFound.noPackageManager: No supported package manager found. Supported: apt (Debian/Ubuntu), dnf (Fedora/RHEL), or pacman (Arch).
packageManagerNotFound.windowsManagerHint: Install winget (App Installer), Chocolatey, Scoop, or npm to check for and install software updates.

softwareUpdater.updateVerificationUnavailable: The update could not be confirmed. Check again before considering the app updated.
softwareUpdater.updateVerificationStillAvailable: The package manager reported completion, but this update is still available.

driverManager.pageDescription: Check Windows Update for driver updates and review old packages before installing or removing them.
driverManager.safeOperationText: Atlas checks Windows Update for available driver updates and identifies packages replaced by a newer version currently in use. After the scan, you choose which updates to install and which packages to remove.
driverManager.safetyWarningDescription: This page checks Windows Update for driver updates and identifies old packages. Scanning does not change your computer. Installing or removing drivers may affect devices and require a restart. On business computers, check with your IT team before applying any changes.
driverManager.problemDevicesDescription: Lists devices Windows flagged with a configuration error, including cases where a driver may be missing.
driverManager.noProblemDevices: Windows did not report any devices with problems.
driverManager.problemScanUnavailable: Could not check device status. Please scan again.
driverManager.queryingWindowsUpdate: Querying Windows Update for driver updates...
driverManager.rebootRequired: A system restart is required to complete the installation.
driverManager.emptyStateDescription: Scan to find available updates and stale driver packages to clean up.
driverManager.allUpToDateTitle: All drivers are up to date
driverManager.allUpToDateDescription: No updates available and no stale packages found.
driverManager.updatesDisabledTitle: Driver updates are turned off in Windows
driverManager.updatesDisabledText: Windows is set to exclude drivers from Windows Update, so Atlas did not check for driver updates. Stale driver package cleanup still works. You can re-enable driver updates in Windows device installation settings or Group Policy.
driverManager.ignoredToastHidden: Atlas won't offer this driver again, and it's now hidden from Windows Update too.
driverManager.ignoredToastNotHidden: Atlas won't offer this driver again, but it couldn't be hidden from Windows Update. Run Atlas as administrator and restore, then ignore it again to hide it there as well.
driverManager.restoredToastNotUnhidden: The driver is back in Atlas's list but couldn't be unhidden in Windows Update. Run Atlas as administrator to change that.
driverManager.ignoreFailedToast: Couldn't update the driver ignore list
driverManager.confirmDescriptionRebootNote: A system restart may be required after installing updates.
driverManager.confirmDescriptionSuffix: Currently active drivers will not be affected.
driverManager.scanFailedDescription: Make sure the app is running as Administrator
driverManager.scanFailedError: Failed to scan driver packages. Make sure the app is running as Administrator.
driverManager.updateScanFailedDescription: Make sure Windows Update service is running
driverManager.updateScanFailedError: Failed to check for driver updates. Make sure Windows Update service is running.
driverManager.installFailedError: Failed to install driver updates. Administrator privileges are required.
driverManager.cleanFailedError: Failed to remove driver packages. Administrator privileges are required.
